quranTranslation.text: By the declining day,

explanation.bs: „Tako mi vremena (al-ʿaṣr)!“ – ٱلْعَصْرِ je u genitivu.
explanation.en: “By the declining day!” – ٱلْعَصْرِ is genitive.

quranTranslation.text: By the morning hours

explanation.bs: „Tako mi jutarnje svjetlosti!“
explanation.en: “By the morning hours!”

quranTranslation.text: Recite unto them the story of Noah, when he told his people: O my people! If my sojourn (here) and my reminding you by Allah's revelations are an offence unto you, in Allah have I put my trust, so decide upon your course of action you and your partners. Let not your course of action be in doubt for you. Then have at me, give me no respite.

explanation.bs: „…pa svoj plan utvrdite zajedno sa svojim ortacima“ – وَشُرَكَآءَكُمْ u akuzativu.
explanation.en: “…so decide upon your course of action you and your partners” – وَشُرَكَآءَكُمْ is accusative: together with your partners.

quranTranslation.text: Or deemed ye that ye would enter paradise while yet Allah knoweth not those of you who really strive, nor knoweth those (of you) who are steadfast?

explanation.bs: „…a Allah još nije pokazao one među vama koji se bore, a ujedno ni one koji su strpljivi“ – وَيَعْلَمَ u subjunktivu.
explanation.en: “…while yet Allah knoweth not those of you who really strive, nor knoweth those (of you) who are steadfast” – وَيَعْلَمَ is subjunctive.

quranTranslation.text: Glorified be He Who carried His servant by night from the Inviolable Place of Worship to the Far distant place of worship the neighbourhood whereof We have blessed, that We might show him of Our tokens! Lo! He, only He, is the Hearer, the Seer.

explanation.bs: „…od Svetog mesdžida do Najudaljenijeg mesdžida“.
explanation.en: “…from the Inviolable Place of Worship to the Far distant place of worship”.

quranTranslation.text: And of mankind are some who say: We believe in Allah and the Last Day, when they believe not.

explanation.bs: „A od ljudi ima onih koji govore…“ – doslovno ‚od ljudi (su) oni koji…‘.
explanation.en: “And of mankind are some who say…”.

gloss.en: ‘some of’: a part of a whole

quranTranslation.text: That (is the command). And whoso magnifieth the sacred things of Allah, it will be well for him in the sight of his Lord. The cattle are lawful unto you save that which hath been told you. So shun the filth of idols, and shun lying speech,

explanation.bs: „Pa klonite se nečistoće koju čine kipovi“ – مِنَ objašnjava šta je ta nečistoća.
explanation.en: “So shun the filth of idols” – مِنَ says what that filth is.

quranTranslation.text: We sent Noah (of old) unto his people, and he said: O my people! Serve Allah. Ye have no other Allah save Him. Lo! I fear for you the retribution of an Awful Day.

explanation.bs: „Nemate nikakvog boga osim Njega“ – مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ: nikakvog boga.
explanation.en: Noah tells his people that besides Him there is no god for them – مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ: not a single deity.

quranTranslation.text: The believers are naught else than brothers. Therefore make peace between your brethren and observe your duty to Allah that haply ye may obtain mercy.

explanation.bs: „Vjernici su zaista samo braća“ – ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ je u nominativu, ne u akuzativu.
explanation.en: “The believers are naught else than brothers” – ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ is nominative, not accusative.

quranTranslation.text: Your wealth and your children are only a temptation, whereas Allah! with Him is an immense reward.

explanation.bs: „Vaši imeci i vaša djeca samo su iskušenje“ – أَمْوَٰلُكُمْ u nominativu.
explanation.en: “Your wealth and your children are only a temptation” – أَمْوَٰلُكُمْ nominative.

quranTranslation.text: Nothing of our revelation (even a single verse) do we abrogate or cause be forgotten, but we bring (in place) one better or the like thereof. Knowest thou not that Allah is Able to do all things?

explanation.bs: „Koji god ajet dokinemo…“ – نَنسَخْ u jusivu.
explanation.en: “Nothing of our revelation (even a single verse) do we abrogate…” – Pickthall turns the conditional مَا (‘whatever … We abrogate’) into ‘nothing … but’; نَنسَخْ is jussive.

quranTranslation.text: Ye will not attain unto piety until ye spend of that which ye love. And whatsoever ye spend, Allah is Aware thereof.

explanation.bs: „A što god od nečega udijelite…“
explanation.en: “And whatsoever ye spend…”

quranTranslation.text: It was by the mercy of Allah that thou wast lenient with them (O Muhammad), for if thou hadst been stern and fierce of heart they would have dispersed from round about thee. So pardon them and ask forgiveness for them and consult with them upon the conduct of affairs. And when thou art resolved, then put thy trust in Allah. Lo! Allah loveth those who put their trust (in Him).

explanation.bs: „Samo zbog milosti od Allaha ti si bio blag prema njima“ – رَحْمَةٍ u genitivu.
explanation.en: “It was by the mercy of Allah that thou wast lenient with them” – رَحْمَةٍ is genitive.

gloss.en: Between a preposition and its noun: emphasis

quranTranslation.text: Then because of their breaking of their covenant, and their disbelieving in the revelations of Allah, and their slaying of the prophets wrongfully, and their saying: Our hearts are hardened - Nay, but Allah set a seal upon them for their disbelief, so that they believe not save a few -

explanation.bs: „Pa zbog njihovog kršenja zavjeta…“ – نَقْضِهِم u genitivu.
explanation.en: “Then because of their breaking of their covenant…” – نَقْضِهِم is genitive.

gloss.en: Between a preposition and its noun: emphasis

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! Seek help in steadfastness and prayer. Lo! Allah is with the steadfast.

explanation.bs: „Allah je doista sa strpljivima“ – ٱللَّهَ u akuzativu.
explanation.en: “Lo! Allah is with the steadfast” – ٱللَّهَ accusative.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! man is a state of loss,

explanation.bs: „Čovjek je zaista u gubitku“ – uz لَـ u predikatu: dvostruko pojačanje.
explanation.en: “Lo! man is a state of loss” – with لَـ in the predicate: emphasis twice over.

quranTranslation.text: And when Moses said unto his people: Lo! Allah commandeth you that ye sacrifice a cow, they said: Dost thou make game of us? He answered: Allah forbid that I should be among the foolish!

explanation.bs: „…kad Musa reče svom narodu: Allah vam zaista naređuje…“
explanation.en: “…when Moses said unto his people: Lo! Allah commandeth you…”

quranTranslation.text: On lined couches,

explanation.bs: „…na izvezenim ležajevima“.
explanation.en: “On lined couches”.

quranTranslation.text: Peace be unto Abraham!

explanation.bs: „Neka je mir na Ibrahimu!“ – doslovno ‚mir na Ibrahima‘.
explanation.en: “Peace be unto Abraham!”

quranTranslation.text: Wherein are plain memorials (of Allah's guidance); the place where Abraham stood up to pray; and whosoever entereth it is safe. And pilgrimage to the House is a duty unto Allah for mankind, for him who can find a way thither. As for him who disbelieveth, (let him know that) lo! Allah is Independent of (all) creatures.

explanation.bs: „A ljudi su Allahu dužni hodočastiti Kuću“ – عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ.
explanation.en: “And pilgrimage to the House is a duty unto Allah for mankind” – عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ.

quranTranslation.text: When two parties of you almost fell away, and Allah was their Protecting Friend. In Allah let believers put their trust.

explanation.bs: „I neka se na Allaha vjernici oslanjaju“.
explanation.en: “In Allah let believers put their trust”.

quranTranslation.text: And whoso doeth good an atom's weight will see it then,

explanation.bs: „Pa ko god učini dobra težine truna, vidjet će ga“ – يَعْمَلْ i يَرَهُ u jusivu.
explanation.en: “And whoso doeth good an atom's weight will see it then” – يَعْمَلْ and يَرَهُ are jussive.

quranTranslation.text: And whoso doeth ill an atom's weight will see it then.

explanation.bs: „A ko god učini zla težine truna, vidjet će ga.“
explanation.en: “And whoso doeth ill an atom's weight will see it then.”

quranTranslation.text: Glorified be He Who carried His servant by night from the Inviolable Place of Worship to the Far distant place of worship the neighbourhood whereof We have blessed, that We might show him of Our tokens! Lo! He, only He, is the Hearer, the Seer.

explanation.bs: „…do Najudaljenijeg mesdžida“.
explanation.en: “…to the Far distant place of worship”.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! unto thy Lord is the return.

explanation.bs: „Doista je tvome Gospodaru povratak“.
explanation.en: “Lo! unto thy Lord is the return”.

quranTranslation.text: It is made lawful for you to go in unto your wives on the night of the fast. They are raiment for you and ye are raiment for them. Allah is Aware that ye were deceiving yourselves in this respect and He hath turned in mercy toward you and relieved you. So hold intercourse with them and seek that which Allah hath ordained for you, and eat and drink until the white thread becometh distinct to you from the black thread of the dawn. Then strictly observe the fast till nightfall and touch them not, but be at your devotions in the mosques. These are the limits imposed by Allah, so approach them not. Thus Allah expoundeth His revelation to mankind that they may ward off (evil).

explanation.bs: „…zatim post upotpunite do noći“.
explanation.en: “Then strictly observe the fast till nightfall”.

quranTranslation.text: Give unto orphans their wealth. Exchange not the good for the bad (in your management thereof) nor absorb their wealth into your own wealth. Lo! that would be a great sin.

explanation.bs: „…i ne jedite njihove imetke (pridružujući ih) svojim imecima“ – ‚jesti‘ sa skrivenim značenjem ‚pridružiti‘ (at-taḍmīn).
explanation.en: “…nor absorb their wealth into your own wealth” – the Arabic verb is ‘consume’ (تَأْكُلُوٓا۟), with the implied sense of ‘add’ (at-taḍmīn).

quranTranslation.text: Save worshippers.

explanation.bs: „Osim onih koji namaz obavljaju“ – ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ u akuzativu.
explanation.en: “Save worshippers” – ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ accusative.

quranTranslation.text: Keep vigil the night long, save a little -

explanation.bs: „Provedi noć stojeći [u namazu], osim malog dijela“ – قَلِيلًا u akuzativu.
explanation.en: “Keep vigil the night long, save a little” – قَلِيلًا accusative.

quranTranslation.text: And there may spring from you a nation who invite to goodness, and enjoin right conduct and forbid indecency. Such are they who are successful.

explanation.bs: „…i odvraćaju od onoga što je loše“.
explanation.en: “…and forbid indecency”.

quranTranslation.text: They ask thee, (O Muhammad), of new moons, say: They are fixed seasons for mankind and for the pilgrimage. It is not righteousness that ye go to houses by the backs thereof (as do the idolaters at certain seasons), but the righteous man is he who wardeth off (evil). So go to houses by the gates thereof, and observe your duty to Allah, that ye may be successful.

explanation.bs: „Pitaju te o mladim mjesecima“.
explanation.en: “They ask thee… of new moons”.

quranTranslation.text: That ye shall journey on from plane to plane.

explanation.bs: „Sigurno ćete prolaziti stanje za stanjem.“
explanation.en: “That ye shall journey on from plane to plane.”

quranTranslation.text: We have seen the turning of thy face to heaven (for guidance, O Muhammad). And now verily We shall make thee turn (in prayer) toward a qiblah which is dear to thee. So turn thy face toward the Inviolable Place of Worship, and ye (O Muslims), wheresoever ye may be, turn your faces (when ye pray) toward it. Lo! Those who have received the Scripture know that (this revelation) is the Truth from their Lord. And Allah is not unaware of what they do.

explanation.bs: „Vidimo kako okrećeš lice svoje prema nebu“.
explanation.en: “We have seen the turning of thy face to heaven”.

quranTranslation.text: Allah already knoweth those of you who hinder, and those who say unto their brethren: "Come ye hither unto us!" and they come not to the stress of battle save a little,

explanation.bs: „Allah već zna one među vama koji odvraćaju…“
explanation.en: “Allah already knoweth those of you who hinder…”

quranTranslation.text: Nothing of our revelation (even a single verse) do we abrogate or cause be forgotten, but we bring (in place) one better or the like thereof. Knowest thou not that Allah is Able to do all things?

explanation.bs: „Zar ne znaš da je Allah nad svakom stvari moćan?“ – ٱللَّهَ u akuzativu.
explanation.en: “Knowest thou not that Allah is Able to do all things?” – ٱللَّهَ accusative.

quranTranslation.text: The forbidden month for the forbidden month, and forbidden things in retaliation. And one who attacketh you, attack him in like manner as he attacked you. Observe your duty to Allah, and know that Allah is with those who ward off (evil).

explanation.bs: „I znajte da je Allah uz bogobojazne“.
explanation.en: “And know that Allah is with those who ward off (evil)”.

quranTranslation.text: O People of the Scripture! Why disbelieve ye in the revelations of Allah, when ye (yourselves) bear witness (to their truth)?

explanation.bs: „O sljedbenici Knjige, zašto poričete Allahove ajete…“ – يَٰٓأَهْلَ u akuzativu.
explanation.en: “O People of the Scripture! Why disbelieve ye in the revelations of Allah…” – يَٰٓأَهْلَ is accusative.

gloss.en: Calling a phrase: ‘O children of Adam!’

quranTranslation.text: O Children of Adam! Look to your adornment at every place of worship, and eat and drink, but be not prodigal. Lo! He loveth not the prodigals.

explanation.bs: „O sinovi Ademovi, uzmite svoj ukras kod svakog mesdžida…“ – يَٰبَنِىٓ, akuzativ množine.
explanation.en: “O Children of Adam! Look to your adornment at every place of worship…” – يَٰبَنِىٓ, the accusative plural.

gloss.en: Calling a phrase: ‘O children of Adam!’

quranTranslation.text: He begetteth not nor was begotten.

explanation.bs: „Nije rodio niti je rođen“ – يَلِدْ u jusivu.
explanation.en: “He begetteth not nor was begotten” – يَلِدْ jussive.

quranTranslation.text: Have We not caused thy bosom to dilate,

explanation.bs: „Zar ti nismo otvorili grudi tvoje?“ – أَلَمْ = أَ + لَمْ.
explanation.en: “Have We not caused thy bosom to dilate” – أَلَمْ = أَ + لَمْ.

quranTranslation.text: A day wherein mankind will be as thickly-scattered moths

explanation.bs: „…ljudi će biti kao rasuti leptiri“.
explanation.en: “…mankind will be as thickly-scattered moths”.

quranTranslation.text: And made them like green crops devoured (by cattle)?

explanation.bs: „I učini ih kao izjedene stabljike“.
explanation.en: “And made them like green crops devoured”.

quranTranslation.text: The Creator of the heavens and the earth. He hath made for you pairs of yourselves, and of the cattle also pairs, whereby He multiplieth you. Naught is as His likeness; and He is the Hearer, the Seer.

explanation.bs: „Ništa nije kao On“ – كَمِثْلِهِۦ.
explanation.en: “Naught is as His likeness” – كَمِثْلِهِۦ.

quranTranslation.text: Who would have had thee compromise, that they may compromise.

explanation.bs: „Voljeli bi da ti popustiš, pa da popuste i oni“ – تُدْهِنُ ostaje u indikativu.
explanation.en: “Who would have had thee compromise, that they may compromise” – تُدْهِنُ stays indicative.

quranTranslation.text: And thou wilt find them greediest of mankind for life and (greedier) than the idolaters. (Each) one of them would like to be allowed to live a thousand years. And to live (a thousand years) would be no means remove him from the doom. Allah is Seer of what they do.

explanation.bs: „…svaki od njih volio bi da poživi hiljadu godina“.
explanation.en: “…one of them would like to be allowed to live a thousand years”.

quranTranslation.text: The wandering Arabs say: We believe. Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Ye believe not, but rather say "We submit," for the faith hath not yet entered into your hearts. Yet, if ye obey Allah and His messenger, He will not withhold from you aught of (the reward of) your deeds. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

explanation.bs: „…a vjera još nije ušla u vaša srca“ – يَدْخُلِ u jusivu.
explanation.en: “…for the faith hath not yet entered into your hearts” – يَدْخُلِ is jussive.

quranTranslation.text: Or deemed ye that ye would enter paradise while yet Allah knoweth not those of you who really strive, nor knoweth those (of you) who are steadfast?

explanation.bs: „…a Allah još nije obznanio one među vama koji su se borili“ – يَعْلَمِ u jusivu.
explanation.en: “…while yet Allah knoweth not those of you who really strive” – يَعْلَمِ is jussive.

quranTranslation.text: (The night is) Peace until the rising of the dawn.

explanation.bs: „Ona je mir, sve do izlaska zore“ – مَطْلَعِ u genitivu.
explanation.en: “Peace until the rising of the dawn” – مَطْلَعِ is genitive.

quranTranslation.text: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad) awhile,

explanation.bs: „Zato se od njih okreni do izvjesnog vremena“ – حِينٍ u genitivu.
explanation.en: “So withdraw from them awhile” – حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ; حِينٍ is genitive.

quranTranslation.text: And serve thy Lord till the Inevitable cometh unto thee.

explanation.bs: „I obožavaj Gospodara svoga dok ti ne dođe ono izvjesno“ – يَأْتِيَكَ u subjunktivu.
explanation.en: “And serve thy Lord till the Inevitable cometh unto thee” – يَأْتِيَكَ is subjunctive.

quranTranslation.text: They will not believe in it till they behold the painful doom,

explanation.bs: „Oni u njega neće vjerovati dok ne vide bolnu kaznu“ – يَرَوُا u subjunktivu.
explanation.en: “They will not believe in it till they behold the painful doom” – يَرَوُا is subjunctive.

quranTranslation.text: Nay, but they will come to know!

explanation.bs: „Nikako! Saznat će!“ – كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ.
explanation.en: “Nay, but they will come to know!” – كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ.

quranTranslation.text: Surely We will ease his way unto the state of ease.

explanation.bs: „Pa ćemo mu olakšati put prema onom lakšem“ – فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ.
explanation.en: “Surely We will ease his way unto the state of ease” – فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ.

quranTranslation.text: He it is Who fashioneth you in the wombs as pleaseth Him. There is no Allah save Him, the Almighty, the Wise.

explanation.bs: „On je Taj koji vas oblikuje u matericama kako hoće.“
explanation.en: “He it is Who fashioneth you in the wombs as pleaseth Him.”

quranTranslation.text: The Jews say: Allah's hand is fettered. Their hands are fettered and they are accursed for saying so. Nay, but both His hands are spread out wide in bounty. He bestoweth as He will. That which hath been revealed unto thee from thy Lord is certain to increase the contumacy and disbelief of many of them, and We have cast among them enmity and hatred till the Day of Resurrection. As often as they light a fire for war, Allah extinguisheth it. Their effort is for corruption in the land, and Allah loveth not corrupters.

explanation.bs: „…naprotiv, obje Njegove ruke su raširene, udjeljuje kako hoće.“
explanation.en: “Nay, but both His hands are spread out wide in bounty. He bestoweth as He will.”

quranTranslation.text: Allah is He Who sendeth the winds so that they raise clouds, and spreadeth them along the sky as pleaseth Him, and causeth them to break and thou seest the rain downpouring from within them. And when He maketh it to fall on whom He will of His bondmen, lo! they rejoice;

explanation.bs: „…pa ih po nebu rasprostire kako hoće…“
explanation.en: “…and spreadeth them along the sky as pleaseth Him…”

quranTranslation.text: Lo! Allah wrongeth not mankind in aught; but mankind wrong themselves.

explanation.bs: „Allah, zaista, ljudima nimalo nepravde ne čini, nego ljudi sami sebi nepravdu čine“ – ٱلنَّاسَ u akuzativu.
explanation.en: “Lo! Allah wrongeth not mankind in aught; but mankind wrong themselves” – ٱلنَّاسَ is accusative.

quranTranslation.text: We verily brought the Truth unto you, but ye were, most of you, averse to the Truth.

explanation.bs: „Donijeli smo vam istinu, ali većina vas istinu prezire“ – أَكْثَرَكُمْ u akuzativu.
explanation.en: “We verily brought the Truth unto you, but ye were, most of you, averse to the Truth” – أَكْثَرَكُمْ is accusative.

quranTranslation.text: Nay, but ye will come to know!

explanation.bs: „Nikako! Znat ćete!“ – سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ.
explanation.en: “Nay, but ye will come to know!” – سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ.

quranTranslation.text: And verily thy Lord will give unto thee so that thou wilt be content.

explanation.bs: „I tvoj Gospodar će ti, sigurno, davati, pa ćeš biti zadovoljan“ – وَلَسَوْفَ: لَـ naglašavanja i سَوْفَ.
explanation.en: “And verily thy Lord will give unto thee so that thou wilt be content” – وَلَسَوْفَ: the لَـ of emphasis and سَوْفَ.

quranTranslation.text: And they said: Whatever portent thou bringest wherewith to bewitch us, we shall not put faith in thee.

explanation.bs: „I rekli su: Koji god nam znak doneseš da nas njime opčiniš, mi ti nećemo vjerovati.“ – تَأْتِنَا je u jusivu.
explanation.en: “And they said: Whatever portent thou bringest wherewith to bewitch us, we shall not put faith in thee.” – تَأْتِنَا is jussive.
